title: Requirement to evidence matrix for the effective slice
readingRule: A gate is GREEN only if its own instrument reports zero failures. Nothing below is summarised upward; a red gate stays red in this table.

gates.result: All invariants hold; 36 self-tests pass, including a sabotage case for the new test-endpoint rule.

gates.detail: One failure: ContainerTests.KillSwitch_Specs.Should_be_degraded_after_too_many_exceptions, 20.0 s in the full run, 3 of 3 green in isolation at 10.4 s. It is first in its fixture, so the shared budget of record 0015 does not explain it. Open.

Measured with the foreign broker stopped, so no result depends on it. Five of the eight red are in Failing_to_connect_to_rabbitmq and are deliberately untouched pending record 0015. Two are the Turnout pair, one is the sporadic delayed family.

Unsatisfiable as configured: 108 tests need SQL Server LocalDB and 31 need PostgreSQL. Neither is a pinned fixture, and LocalDB does not exist on Linux, so the ubuntu runner cannot satisfy this gate either. 16 tests need no database and pass.

gates.result: 33 packages, exit code 0, hashed, nothing published.
gates.caveat: ViciOne.ServiceBus.MessagePack carries a High advisory through MessagePack 3.1.6.

gates.detail: Both brokers started, so the artemis branch runs instead of falling back to a fixed port.

summary.whyNot: Three gates are red and record 0015 is unanswered. The entity-framework gate cannot be satisfied without a decision on database fixtures, which is a scope decision.

environmentPinning.why: Two cron cases build a template hour in one offset and reuse it across 31 October 2010, the day of a European DST transition. They fail in CEST and pass in UTC: measured 3 of 5 against 5 of 5. Pinning the zone removes an environment difference between a local run and the runner; it weakens no assertion.
